title: Drip conversion for an Esquimalt church garden

seo.title: Sample project: Esquimalt drip conversion | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: spray heads in an Esquimalt church garden converted to drip irrigation for beds and shrubs, with a simple controller. Request a free quote.

summary: Spray heads in shrub beds converted to drip lines for a volunteer-run garden.
scope: Spray to drip conversion in four beds
story: Volunteers were hand-adjusting spray heads that soaked the walkways.
We converted the beds to drip, installed a simple controller and showed volunteers how to pause it for rain.
Read more about [irrigation](/services/irrigation/), see our work in [Esquimalt](/areas/esquimalt/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
result: Water goes to the plants, not the paths, and volunteers can run the system.
